verification: All original hashes/sizes and containment verified at entry and exit; no symlinks. Every CAS object exact SHA/size/mode0444 readback; exclusive temp/fsync/atomic nonreplacing renamex_np RENAME_EXCL and directory fsync. Alias indexes form exact partition with matching hashes/sizes.
preservation: All original failures, repair/review attribution and proposal/preparation statuses unchanged; V86 failed sweep does not become acceptance. No recursive upstream references copied.
cleanup: All new temp objects atomically published; no originals or prior objects removed/overwritten; no background work.
scope: Ten selected owning manifests/direct members and ten explicit standalones only; brief and selection hash-bound as context. No active V89 output/source access.
limits: Host-local derivative CAS; non-WORM, non-clone-portable; preservation only, no acceptance or closure. No source/policy/Git/runtime changes.
